items.title: Sebi working to delist companies with no economic activity: Chairman
items.description: There are a number of listed companies with no economic activity, Sebi chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey said

items.title: Sebi extends digital accessibility compliance deadline to January 31
items.description: The requirements are part of Sebi's earlier circulars on mandatory compliance with the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016, and the rules framed thereunder by all regulated entities

items.title: Gold, silver may extend losses as US vote, jobs data test sentiment
items.description: Gold and silver may extend their losses as investors track the US midterm election, jobs data, geopolitical tensions and global economic indicators for cues on bullion prices.

items.title: India's 10-year bond yield may ease to 6.75-7% by March: SBI Research
items.description: SBI Research sees the 10-year G-sec yield easing by March 2027, citing historical yield spreads and steps to lower government borrowing, despite a possible 50-basis-point rate hike.

items.title: Geopolitical risks, crude oil and earnings to steer markets this week
items.description: Geopolitical tensions, crude oil prices and September-quarter earnings are set to drive market sentiment, with US midterm elections and foreign investor flows also in focus.

items.title: Dixon Technologies faces near-term margin headwinds as input costs rise
items.description: Strong mobile revenue growth and market share gains support Dixon Technologies, but the end of production-linked incentives, higher input costs and delayed Vivo JV production weigh on margins

items.title: Street signs: Multi-asset funds lose winning edge, FPIs back at buy table
items.description: Multi-asset funds deliver an average return of just 1.4% as weakness across asset classes erodes diversification benefits; FPIs show tentative signs of returning to Indian equities
